title: When you need to|know who He is
verse: For I am the LORD who heals you.

title: When you need to|remember what He does
verse: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases
source: biblehub.com BSB, 25 Nov 2026 (closing comma of the verse left off)

title: When you look|at the cross
verse: But He was pierced for our transgressions, He was crushed for our iniquities; the punishment that brought us peace was upon Him, and by His stripes we are healed.

title: When you are the|one who is sick
verse: Heal me, O LORD, and I will be healed; save me, and I will be saved, for You are my praise.

title: When you need|His word
verse: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.

title: When you wonder what|Jesus came to do
verse: How God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, and how Jesus went around doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, because God was with Him.
source: biblehub.com BSB context, 25 Nov 2026 (first word capitalised)

title: When healing|comes
verse: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.

title: When someone|asks you to pray
verse: Is any one of you sick? He should call the elders of the church to pray over him and anoint him with oil in the name of the Lord. And the prayer offered in faith will restore the one who is sick.
source: biblehub.com BSB context and heartlight.org, 25 Nov 2026

title: Before you pray|for someone
verse: They will lay their hands on the sick, and they will be made well.

title: When you ask
verse: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.

title: When you are waiting|to be well
verse: But I will restore your health and heal your wounds, declares the LORD.

title: Keep His words|close
verse: My son, pay attention to my words; incline your ear to my sayings. Do not lose sight of them; keep them within your heart. For they are life to those who find them, and health to the whole body.

title: When you pray|for a friend
verse: Beloved, I pray that in every way you may prosper and enjoy good health, as your soul also prospers.

title: What He carried|for you
verse: He took up our infirmities and carried our diseases.

title: When you wonder|if He cares
verse: When He stepped ashore and saw a large crowd, He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

title: When you wonder|if He has changed
verse: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.

title: When you are sent
verse: Heal the sick, raise the dead, cleanse the lepers, drive out demons. Freely you have received; freely give.

title: When you feel too ordinary|to pray for the sick
verse: Truly, truly, I tell you, whoever believes in Me will also do the works that I am doing. He will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.

title: When you do not know|where else to turn
verse: Call to Me, and I will answer and show you great and unsearchable things you do not know.

title: When you need to know|He keeps His word
verse: God is not a man, that He should lie, or a son of man, that He should change His mind.

title: When you speak|His word
verse: So My word that proceeds from My mouth will not return to Me empty, but it will accomplish what I please, and it will prosper where I send it.

title: When you reach out|to Him
verse: “Daughter,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be free of your affliction.”

title: When you are waiting|for the morning
verse: But for you who fear My name, the sun of righteousness will rise with healing in its wings.

title: When the heart|is broken too
verse: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.

title: When you need|to be near Him
verse: The entire crowd was trying to touch Him, because power was coming from Him and healing them all.

title: When you are tired|of praying
verse: Let us not grow weary in well-doing, for in due time we will reap a harvest if we do not give up.
